localizedDescriptions.zh: 可自定义的应用启动器小组件，支持多份小组件配置：每个小组件通过参数选择自己的展示内容。大尺寸可分区展示多个文件夹，每个区域都能独立设置布局与外观；SF Symbol 可视化搜索选择并支持填充等样式，支持单应用、双应用、三/四/六/九宫格与自动网格布局，数据保存在 iCloud 共享数据储存库中。
localizedDescriptions.en: A customizable launcher widget for your favourite apps and folders. Several widgets can each show different content by naming a saved profile in their parameter, and large widgets can divide into folder panels that are each configured independently, and SF Symbols can be picked from a searchable catalogue with styles such as Fill, with single, dual and 3/4/6/9-grid or auto-grid layouts. Data lives in an iCloud shared data store.
